Founded in 2018, Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University is a private university. It is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh. The institute is accredited with PCI and AICTE. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University provides UG, PG and After 10th courses in both Full Time and Part Time modes. It provides 129 courses across specialisations such as Automobile Engineering, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Botany and Chemistry. Some of the courses offered at this institute include B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, Executive MBA/PGDM and B.Sc. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University fees ranges between INR 12,500 to 3,99,000. The student intake for these courses is 5998. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University offers these course across fields such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce and Design. Shri Rawatpura Sarkar University offers all the campus facilities to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Our college provides good education and campus life.

review_content.Placements: Our college provides excellent placements. The lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA and the highest salary package offered is 11 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library is excellent. More than 5,000 books are available in the library. All departments have their libraries, so you can easily find books according to your needs. University has four central libraries.
review_content.Faculty: The pattern of exams at this university is good. Question papers are prepared by teachers. The teaching quality is good. Our teachers are well-educated. They complete the entire course in chapters.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: This college is the best of all time; its faculty is good. Its placement is better.

review_content.Placements: In our college placement rate of 90%, this is the highest rate in our country. There are mostly the highest packages offered in our college, ranging from INR 50 lacs to 2.5 lacs per annum. Cipla, Lupin, and Reddy's Laboratory are the other three most popular recruiting firms. In 2016, 60% of students got internships at CIPA. The top roles are analytical chemist, food and drug inspector, and drug therapist.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a highly digital Wi-Fi connection for better studies. Also, its labs are wonderful and clean. The hostel is very clean, and the food is very tasty and healthy. And in the sports category, our college ranks in the No. 1 position. And there are many more games like chess, carrom, football, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Diploma in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Teachers are excellent and they are Educated and knowledgeable too and as a student we are.

review_content.Placements: The highest is 500000 to 700000 per year CSPDCL AND OTHER ELECTRICITY OFFICES 90 percent AND OTHER ELECTRICITY OFFICES LIKE RAILWAYS ELECTRICIAN we have parking too and hostels tooo hostels are very good and fully secure, no outsiders can enter to our hostel campus with out any information .
review_content.Infrastructure: Very good infrastructure and very good and calm environment Security is also sooo good and they take care of usss and campus has a canteen too where we can enjoy our meals very nice experience we are experiencing, we have parking too and hostels tooo hostels are very good and fully secure, no outsiders can enter to our hostel campus with out any information .

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Helpful faculty, Decent Infrastructure, But No connectivity to the main city.

review_content.Placements: There can be better opportunities for the students. I believe the current placement structure doesn't put much emphasis on getting the students good packages. From what I've seen, a very small percentage of students get places with decent packages. Scope for improvement!
review_content.Infrastructure: I haven't been to the hostel, but for my course, we're placed in the B block, and I guess all the blocks have fully functional elevator, the classrooms are tidy, but it can be tough to sit there for prolonged hours during summer. I guess, rest is fine.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: It is an excellent learning institute in Raipur.

review_content.Placements: In our college, almost 80% of students got placed. The lowest salary package offered was 3 LPA and the highest salary package offered was 20 LPA. Top recruiting companies visited our campus. Almost 80% of students got internships.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities were average. The quality of the food was good. Sports were excellent. The library was good. The seating arrangement was excellent. Many books were available.
review_content.Faculty: The teaching quality was excellent. Lectures were beneficial for students. The course curriculum was relevant. Almost 60% of students were industry-ready. Semester exams were easy. The pass percentage was 80%.

reviews_list.review_title: If you want good placements and college life without attending regularly, this college is suitable.

review_content.Placements: About 50% of students get placed in this course. The highest package is 4 crore, and the average package is 6 LPA. Companies like HCL Tech, Wipro, Infosys, Amazon, Flipkart, and others visit the college for placements. Around 70% of students get internships in small tech companies like IT Park Indore. Senior and junior software engineer roles are offered in this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has very good infrastructure. The red-colored building looks attractive. Wi-Fi, bus facilities, labs, and the library are available for students. Separate hostels for girls and boys are available. The mess provides decent-quality food, and the café and canteen offer good food items. An emergency medical team is present in the college. Sports and games events are organized regularly.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: Faculty is good, and their approach to teaching is also good.

review_content.Placements: Many companies will come but mainly for marketing. Packages provided by the company were also decent. The highest placement till now is 9 LPA, and the lowest would be 3 LPA. I would say that choosing marketing + finance, and it will grow the chances of getting us into a good company.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms were provided with either 3 seaters or 4 seaters. The architecture students were sometimes provided with 2 seaters as they require the room. We had 4 wings for all 4 years. First year students were in a separate hostel then 2nd, 3rd, and 4th. We had wings in the hostel area. Water coolers were provided. Wi-Fi was also provided.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: In CS and its related branches, the average package is 3-5 LPA.

review_content.Placements: B.Tech CS normal placements are going like an average of 3-5 LPA. In management, there is a good placement going on. Several companies are coming to the IPS Academy. Some bulk recruiters also come in the IPS, but the package they provide is very basic. Almost 40% of students are placed in IPS. The highest package is of 25 LPA in the mechanical department. TCS, Infosys, and more are bulk recruiters. Almost 90% students get internships in our college, in our course, we become AI engineers and many more.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good here. There are proper labs and everything for students. The Bajaj group and clubs are here for innovation and making something new. Infrastructure is quite good in the IPS Academy. IPS has to improve some technical teaching faculty in CS and other related branches. IPS provides several courses on B.Tech, B.Pharma, B.Com, management, architecture, and many more, but the best course in IPS is B.Com and management because it also has a very high placement rate in Indore.

reviews_list.review_title: Very good college for all students of pharmacy and engineering.

review_summary.college_name: IPS Academy Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: If you want good placements and college life without attending regularly, this college is suitable.

content.Placements: About 50% of students get placed in this course. The highest package is 4 crore, and the average package is 6 LPA. Companies like HCL Tech, Wipro, Infosys, Amazon, Flipkart, and others visit the college for placements. Around 70% of students get internships in small tech companies like IT Park Indore. Senior and junior software engineer roles are offered in this course.
content.Infrastructure: The college has very good infrastructure. The red-colored building looks attractive. Wi-Fi, bus facilities, labs, and the library are available for students. Separate hostels for girls and boys are available. The mess provides decent-quality food, and the café and canteen offer good food items. An emergency medical team is present in the college. Sports and games events are organized regularly.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Faculty is good, and their approach to teaching is also good.

content.Placements: Many companies will come but mainly for marketing. Packages provided by the company were also decent. The highest placement till now is 9 LPA, and the lowest would be 3 LPA. I would say that choosing marketing + finance, and it will grow the chances of getting us into a good company.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms were provided with either 3 seaters or 4 seaters. The architecture students were sometimes provided with 2 seaters as they require the room. We had 4 wings for all 4 years. First year students were in a separate hostel then 2nd, 3rd, and 4th. We had wings in the hostel area. Water coolers were provided. Wi-Fi was also provided.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: In CS and its related branches, the average package is 3-5 LPA.

content.Placements: B.Tech CS normal placements are going like an average of 3-5 LPA. In management, there is a good placement going on. Several companies are coming to the IPS Academy. Some bulk recruiters also come in the IPS, but the package they provide is very basic. Almost 40% of students are placed in IPS. The highest package is of 25 LPA in the mechanical department. TCS, Infosys, and more are bulk recruiters. Almost 90% students get internships in our college, in our course, we become AI engineers and many more.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is quite good here. There are proper labs and everything for students. The Bajaj group and clubs are here for innovation and making something new. Infrastructure is quite good in the IPS Academy. IPS has to improve some technical teaching faculty in CS and other related branches. IPS provides several courses on B.Tech, B.Pharma, B.Com, management, architecture, and many more, but the best course in IPS is B.Com and management because it also has a very high placement rate in Indore.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharma.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Very good college for all students of pharmacy and engineering.

content.Placements: IPS Institute is one of the most known colleges for placement. The average package is 5 to 8 LPA per year. Our college has a good reputation, which helps us in interviews. More than 20 to 30 companies come for recruitment. Internship programs are there for building students’ knowledge about work.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Our college has a very big ground nearby of 5 acres. Hostel is very big, nearby 4000 students live there. Hostel gives good quality of food and many variety of foods, Wi-Fi, mineral water, and many more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Very good for students who want to study and also want to enjoy their college life.

content.Placements: Placement is pretty much okay, not too bad or good. Companies come there, but the qualification required for an interview is very strict. Compared to their packages, the strictness is not good. But the overall average for placement. It gives an average package of 4 LPA to 5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are not too big compared to a college campus. The infrastructure of the college is very good. It is extremely well-organised. There is a very big ground for the students. Swimming, chess, dance, and many other things are organised by the college.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Bihar for MBBS.
reviews.review_text: In our college, infrastructure is very good. There is an academic building in which every department has its own separate block on a different floor. There are four hostel buildings for approximately 600 undergraduate students, including girls hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Best Government Medical college of Bihar. It has a huge campus which is neat and clean.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is morden in my college. Accadmic building have centralized air conditioning system. It also have Wi-Fi. Labs are well-equipped with well qualified staff. Library it three story building, good enough to accommodate all the students at a time. Library building also have Wi-Fi facility.

reviews.review_heading: It has the best medical college life in Bihar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good and is expanding continuously. It is spread over 132 acres of land. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostels and laboratories are well-equipped with modern instruments. The library is air-conditioned. There is a big ground opposite to boys' hostel. There are four lecture theatres in the main college building which are fully air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and campus are very good and attractive.
reviews.review_text:
The college has excellent infrastructure and all the necessary amenities. Some of the facilities are listed below:
Library: The College has a fully-equipped library with a wide variety of books for everyone to read. Hostel: There are separate well-furnished hostels for boys and girls. The hostels have all the facilities for the comfort of students. Cafeteria: A cafeteria is present on campus for the students to hang out. It provides good quality hygienic food at a reasonable price.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best government college for medical in Bihar.
reviews.review_text: It's has a great infrastructure and has the best clinical practice of any other government medical college in Bihar. It also has new machines and equipment, and well-skilled professors. Hostel too can accommodate a large number of students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IGIMS Patna, Bihar.
reviews.review_text: IGIMS campus is the second largest campus (area wise) after DMCH located in Darbhanga district of Bihar. IGIMS has very well built infrastructure. New MBBS boys' hostel has four lifts, two in each wing of the hostel. A helipad is also being constructed on the roof of the cancer department building.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college, and I am fully satisfied with this college. I recommend it to all of you.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and campus are so big and amazing that you cannot do a full tour without a bicycle. In my college, lighting is fully installed, Wi-Fi is good, the central library is fully air-conditioned, with Wi-Fi installation, and no noise inside. In my lab, the equipment is new.

reviews.review_heading: IGIMS is the best in Bihar over any other government medical college of Bihar (AIMS, Patna).
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure at IGIMS, Patna, provides adequate living space designed for student comfort. General cleanliness is maintained across both the hostel and campus areas. Routine upkeep ensures a tidy environment conducive to learning. Overall, the facilities are functional and present a well-kept appearance. This contributes to a positive living and academic experience for residents.

reviews.review_heading: Large and well-equipped college.
reviews.review_text: Our campus looks like a small town. The academic building is fully air-conditioned. Classrooms lecture theaters have AC, fans, projectors, comfortable seating, and a sound system for lectures. All labs of the respective departments are fully equipped with necessary instruments and facilities. A spacious library is available. Our college also offers well-maintained hostel facilities, which cost Rs. 20,000 per annum. The mess food is superb. There is also a large ground for football and cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's good. If you're interested in nursing, this will be the cheapest and best option.
reviews.review_text: Course is good. You get Wi-Fi. They have labs, be it bio, chem, computer, experiments, or practicals, also a library. Classrooms are also digital, not all of them. Food in the mess is okay. Canteen doesn't have much. You can go out. Some sports or games you can play, but will not be provided by the mess or college. You can buy badminton, football, etc. They have medical assistance.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college for students.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good, and it is available 24X7. The mess is better, and library is available 24X7. Wi-Fi connection is the best, and classrooms are better. The connectivity is good.

reviews.review_heading: I am very much satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: It has huge library and it also has new college building which is undergoing construction. Medical facilities are one of the best in Bihar. The Wi-Fi is good and it has very good strength but it is only available for students and academic staff. It has labs in every department.

review_summary.college_name: ITM University Gwalior Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Peaceful campus and good teaching, but limited agriculture-specific opportunities.

content.Placements: 70% students are placed from my course. 45 LPA is the highest package, and 6 LPA is the average. Visa Steel, FedEx recruit. 40-50% students get internships. Quality testing, entry-level argo jobs, and agriculture-related roles are offered. Many students say agriculture-specific placements are limited.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are well-equipped, and classrooms are very decent, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7. In the hostel, beds and rooms are very good. Food is good compared to others. The hostel is on campus with security and basic amenities. The college conducts sports every week.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the infrastructure, faculty, and the MD.

content.Placements: The top roles offered were quality testing and HR roles in the agriculture department, with an average package of 6 LPA. Companies like Country Delight, Cognizant, and Rentokil came and offered good packages. Overall, good companies came and offered good packages to bachelor's degree freshers, and the offers were truly based on potential.
content.Infrastructure: Girls hostel was good, neat, and clean. The only thing was that the housekeeping staff did not clean inside the rooms due to security reasons. The guards were also good. The new hostel was better than the old one, but there were fewer rooms, so you need to book early.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: I did not have a good experience. I am disappointed with it.

content.Placements: So after spending a year preparing for AIPMT, I choose ITM University, Gwalior, and B.Sc. Biotechnology course, which is the biggest mistake of my life. After 1st year, I understood one thing the college is a real disaster in everything. There are low placements and no future. If we want to waste our time we can select ITM University, Gwalior.
content.Infrastructure: Now, I do not know what has changed but in my college time facilities are like nothing. Our class is on the top floor and in summer there are no coolers and fans do not work properly. There is no Wi-Fi at that time. The library is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.A B.Ed. - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Expanding experiences. College life will be a roller coaster life for students. Live it once.

content.Placements: In our field, we do not have any placements. Because we need to find a desired school for our teaching based on the interview which we will qualify for the school. We don't need placements because we have to choose the schools according to our desires and needs.
content.Infrastructure: We have all the infrastructure and facilities like labs and library. But the classrooms lack lighting. There should be more light in the class. Wi-Fi is working but some places have less connectivity. We have all the good hostel facilities. But only the mess food varies from good to little good. We have good medical facilities as the ITM itself has its own hospital. To an extent little of the things are free.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Biotechnology - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and happening events.

content.Placements: About 70% of students got placements in the year 2024. Many companies like Infosys, Adani, etc., visit our college to conduct placements. The highest salary package offered ranges from 5-6 LPA in our course. Roles like HR, consultant, and assistant are offered in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides clean and developed laboratories, machinery, and all the equipment required for research. We have air-conditioned libraries, Wi-Fi, clean classrooms, Labs, etc. Hostels are available for both boys and girls. Medical facilities are available all the time. We get healthy food in the mess. We also have a very vast sports department with all the varieties of sports.

admission_overview.college_name: ITM University Gwalior Admission 2025 (Open): Courses, Eligibility, Dates & Application Process

paragraphs: ITM University, Gwalior admission 2025 is open. The institute offers a wide range of UG, PG, Integrated, Diploma and PhD courses through its different schools namely— theSchool of Engineeringand Technology, Computer Applications, Management, Education, Art & Design, Science, Physical Education and Law.ITM Universityaccepts admissions to its courses on an entrance basis. Students need to clear the institute's entrance test;ITM NEST. The institute also accepts valid scores obtained by the candidates in other national-level exams, such as CAT, CMAT, and more. Aspirants can get all the details regarding the admission procedure, criteria, scholarships, and courses offered at the university in the following article.

ITM University Gwalioroffers admissions to its courses based on the entrance exam conducted by the university. It also accepts valid scores obtained in national-level entrance exams. All of the courses offered at ITM University are in regular mode. Find below the key highlights forITM University admissions 2025:

Further, it offers variousintegrated, diploma and PhD coursesin disciplines ofScience, Management, Engineering & Technology, Education and more. ITM University admission for some courses is granted on the basis of valid scores in the national/state-level entrance exams. The university also conducts its own entrance exam—ITM NEST for admission to the majority of the courses. Find below the eligibility and selection criteria forITM University Gwalior courses:

The admission procedure for ITM University includes several steps, such as application, selection, and admission confirmation. The college accepts admissions to its programmes on scores obtained by the students in the entrance exams. Interested candidates can visit the college's official website to obtain the application form. The entire application process is online. Below is the step-wiseadmission process of ITM University:
Step 1: ITM University Application Process

Interested candidates who fulfil the specified eligibility can visit the official website of ITM University to fill out the application form online. Candidates need to select the desired course, fill in all the specified details, pay the application fee and upload the required documents to complete the registration. Students can either purchase the application form from the admission campus or choose to fill out the form online.
Step 2: ITM University Selection Process

ITM University shortlists applicants on the basis of merit obtained in entrance exams such as JEE Main, CAT, and CMAT. For some of the courses, written tests, interviews, and group discussions will be conducted and will be considered for admissions, with due consideration of academic records and work experience.
Step 3: Counselling and Fee Payment

Once the candidates are shortlisted, they will have to go through counselling for seat allocation. The shortlisted candidates will have to pay the course fee and submit the required documents to confirm their seat in the college.

reviews.review_heading: I liked ITM Campus. When you enter, you get to experience good infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: For this batch, I would not recommend this college.

The canteen facilities are average. The college offers a solid educational foundation, particularly in the field of agriculture.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty members and campus experience.
reviews.review_text: The girls' hostel has two buildings, one with all triple and quadruple rooms and the other with only double rooms. The charges are quite high, around INR 90,000 for a double and INR 80,000 for a triple or quad. The hostel has a few faculty members, so students cannot make noise at night. If you want to live off campus, it will take about 20 minutes to get to school, a...

reviews.review_heading: Perks of the unwanted college but became my favourite .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of ITM is well defined and also the classrooms are average, but the library system of our college is one of the best libraries in such colleges around. The infrastructure also includes an open theatre called Naad and it has playgrounds for all outdoor sports. Also, it has little as well as a huge garden area for some personal events and other events organised by the clubs and the ITM itself.

reviews.review_heading: ITM University B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, it has greenery everywhere, and the campus is also a little bit. Labs are also good. You can easily access the library by just your ID card. In the hostel, you get a bed, a study table, and a balcony. I think that is good enough. Food quality is also good. The college has its own hospital, so you can easily access medical facilities, you just only need to pay medicine charges.

reviews.review_heading: A good college with everything nice - faculty, people, environment, and a lively campus.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of ITM is top-notch and appears very expensive. Wi-Fi is provided, and there are spacious libraries with AC and personal computers for students to work on. All the labs are spacious, and classrooms are good. In the hostel, the food is average, but the canteens are great. The hospital is 1 km away from the hostel, and all facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend joining this college for your overall development.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel is good. The hostel provides good food. It has very strict timing. Boys must enter the hostel before 7 pm. Girls must enter the hostel before 5 pm. Our college provides 24X7 security, electricity, and water.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and infrastructure.

paragraphs: Pursuing MBA at ITM university is not considered to be compartively expensive as the cost matches the quality they provide . The Track of placement rate and education quality does  justifies the fees paid. The make the college accessible as the provide various finacial aid and college loan system. It provides  a well-defined curriculum, course structure and offers a practical learning environment to the students. ITMUR organizes regular training sessions, workshops, industry visits, live interaction with the experts etc. to give an overall learning experience to the students.

ITM University, Gwalior offers various specialisations in BTech, MBA, BSc, UG Diploma, Certificate, MSc, BPT, BMLT etc. The University offers these programmes with the tuition fees ranging between INR 16 K- INR 8.1 Lakh. The ITM University, Gwalior fee structure may vary depending on the level and duration of the programme. Apart from the tuition fees, all the programmes entail one-time fees, which may vary course to course.
The cost of pursuing an MBA at ITM University, Raipur varies depending on the specific programme chosen:

MBA/PGDM Program: The MBA/PGDM programme at ITM University, Raipur is priced at Rs 4.45 Lakhs per year. Therefore, for the full two-year duration of the program, the total cost would be Rs 8.90 Lakhs.

MBA iConnect Program: The MBA iConnect programme at ITM University, Raipur is priced slightly higher, at Rs 5.45 Lakhs per year. Thus, the total cost for the two-year duration would amount to Rs 10.90 Lakhs.

ITM University is a multidisciplinary private university located in Gwalior, offering subjects in various fields such as sciences, engineering, management, fine arts, social sciences, arts, and nursing. The ITM University Gwalior M.Tech course fee (2 Years) is 84,000 INR (Yearly).

reviews.review_heading: Sri Aurobindo Institute of Pharmacy is a good college for study.
reviews.review_text: The college is spread over a very large area and has many facilities. There are labs equipped with modern equipment for students. Modern classes are available where students are taught using projectors. There is a big ground for playing football and basketball. There is also a net for cricket.

reviews.review_heading: Great Professors and pleasant campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is vast and covers all the necessities of a student. The library has all the necessary books. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with the necessary stuff. Labs are also great with constant maintenance. The canteen offers a variety of food choices. Sports and medical facilities are available. Medical facilities are free due to the hospital being on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my college. These all make a good and respectful person in life.
reviews.review_text: Labs are good and well-cleaned. Classrooms are in a large area. The library provides all types of author books. Every subject has a minimum of 10-15 books with different knowledge. There is a good environment in the college with all facilities available. A canteen is present outside of the college.

reviews.review_heading: Placement is best.
reviews.review_text: There are well managed infrastructure of college and, and wellfurnished digital classrooms and Wi-Fi network available in the hostels and facility available just like home. And college gives all the chemical which required to perform practical in the lab .

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: There is no hostel provided for pharmacy students in our college. The infrastructure of the pharmacy department is really good. They have all types of laboratories with every necessary equipment for practicals. There is a library and nice classrooms.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college because there is no college in Madhya Pradesh for a doctor of pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average, and there is not much facility. Hostel facility is not good, and medical facilities are great. Library is good but laboratory facility is not good. Wi-Fi is available in this college, and hostel study rooms are also available in hostel. The sports facilities are also available in college.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the college and this course. It provides the best placements.
reviews.review_text: There is a hostel facility for students. The hostel facility is good, and the food served is also good here. A Wi-Fi facility is available. Labs and classrooms are clean. There are more than thousands of books in the library.

reviews.review_heading: This is a good college with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: This is an old college and the infrastructure is average. Classrooms are good with Wi-Fi. The library is big with a huge collection of books, but sometimes students can't find the book of their choice. College has a hostel within its campus, and many students choose a hostel. Mess food average.

reviews.review_heading: It's quite average college. Faculty members are below average and good placement in 2023.
reviews.review_text: We have good practical labs. There is no Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are good. We also have a good library. Hostels are not available for any branches except MBBS. The canteen has quite good food. They have some sports facilities like basketball, football, cricket, volleyball, throwball, and badminton.

reviews.review_heading: My college is very good; they provide internship opportunities, and 100% placements are available.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available in our college, like different subject labs, all chemicals, a computer lab, library, and projectors in all classes. Annual functions and technical events are also held by the college. Cognois is the name of the annual function held once a year.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Aurobindo Institute of Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: Laboratories, classrooms, Wi-Fi, ground, library, etc., are available in our college. The food served in the canteen is good. There is a hospital attached to our college. All games are promoted in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Aurobindo Institute of Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: That building is new and very good. You can roam anywhere in the college. There is no hostel facility for pharmacy students and students cannot use Wi-Fi. It is only available for faculty. Classrooms are too small. There are games, but there are no sports. The food quality is excellent, but the price is a bit high. Cleanliness is good in our college.

reviews.review_heading: The college has all the necessary basic amenities required for students.
reviews.review_text: The college has all the necessary basic amenities required for students. The hostels are above average, and the food served is average. The college provides games like football, cricket, volleyball, badminton, basketball, and chess.

faqs.question: Does Welingkar Mumbai offer MBA programme?
faqs.answer: At the postgraduate level, Welingkar Institute of Management Mumbai offers a two-year PGDM programme across General and seven other specialisations. This two-year full-time course is the flagship course of WeSchool. This PGDM programme is equivalent to the MBA course. However, the students get a Diploma after completion and not the MBA degree.

faqs.question: When can I apply for MBA course at Welingkar Mumbai?
faqs.answer: Welingkar Mumbai opens its admission portal for the MBA course twice. Firstly in the mid of Novemeber, and secondly in late February. Therefore, candidates with relevant scores in entrance exam ( CAT/ CMAT/ ATMA/ XAT/ MAT) can get admission to the course during any one phase. Moreover, the institute also releases the deadline when it opens its application portal. Thus, candidates must visit the official website to track the admission dates and deadlines.

reviews.review_heading: MBA people with lack of extracurricular activity.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well-equipped with air conditioners, fireproof, digital screens with all wall speakers. Library has enough books for daily lectures. Hostels are well maintained but food isn’t included, electricity is free with washing machines. Only 2-occupant rooms were available.

reviews.review_heading: Welingkar Mumbai: m&e review 2024 good course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is nice. It has Wi-Fi, well-built classrooms with smart boards, an amphitheater, an auditorium, a canteen, and much more. The college has hostels, not within campus, but in nearby areas like Dadar, Wadala, and Matunga. It doesn't provide food, only stay.

reviews.review_heading: Live, make college life memorable.
reviews.review_text: I am from the Corona batch, didn't enjoy college life, but have an idea about facilities. College provides Wi-Fi all day, Computer Labs are well-designed, having all software. The library is good. It has all books, novels, journals, but 15 days is the validity of a book. The college provides rented flats as a hostel. There are AC and non-AC, single, shared rooms available. Food facilities are not available; we need to avail ourselves of a private mess. The sports ground has cricket, football, an...

reviews.review_heading: Review of PGDM at We School.
reviews.review_text: The lack of an outdoor sports field on campus is not ideal. The college is located in Matunga, which has high living costs. The college has 800 students, but there is too much crowding on campus. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel, canteen and campus. The library is both digital and traditional. The hostel facility is not good. There are so many problems in the hostel. The most important thing is that food quality is not very good.

reviews.review_heading: The worst institute, unworthy.
reviews.review_text: The hostel was the worst; there were no facilities, and there was dirt all around. The institute is overall the worst in everything. There is no place for sports activities, and there is no exposure to any activities. The batchmates were the worst, with behavior issues and no knowledge of how to socialize.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and management of the college.
reviews.review_text: The college has a well-developed infrastructure. The college campus is secured with CCTV cameras. The facilities provided by the college are really good. The labs at the college are properly working. The college library has all kinds of books. The hostel at the college is also good. Food in the hostel mess and canteen is good to eat. Overall, I am satisfied with the college facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A bit of a rollercoaster ride but overall a good experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good and it will make you feel as if you are in a 5 star hotel, be it the classrooms, leisure rooms, dorm rooms, gaming room. The canteen and the library are well maintained. Toilets are always  clean and the classrooms have well conditioned AC with big monitors and projectors.

reviews.review_heading: Good experience with the teaching methods, attended lectures online and gained ample knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities were good and the classrooms had ample space with ventilation. The library had books which helped in gaining that extra part and the books and all the study material provided was up to date. I was a distance learning student so I don't have any idea about the food quality.

reviews.review_heading: I'd say that the placement packages are below average in our college.
reviews.review_text: The institute adapted to technology during covid well. The entire library was digitalised. We had a vast collection of newspapers, articles, and research papers available. Newspapers from almost 55 different countries were available for students to read. A lot of course-specific clubs, magazines, and associations were present in the college. We had centralised air-conditioned classrooms, a projector, and all the other basic facilities which were needed. Sports and extracurricular did not happen ...

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with facilities but not hostels.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. There are places around campus to hang around anytime along with a canteen in college. There is a huge library and e-library with several books, journals, and magazines. College gives access to various terminals like Bloomberg and others too. Welingkar has 4 hostel facilities,  2 for boys and 2 for girls. They are at a distance of 2 km to 5 km from the campus in the Matunga area. There is no mess facility inside the hostel but there is a basic canteen f...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Welingkar Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: The lectures are not held in the main building of Welingkar Institute but in the adjacent college of Ruia and Podar which is the partner college. The classrooms are not clean, and the benches are small and uncomfortable. We were not allowed to go to the main building of Welingkars.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Welingkar Institute of Management.
reviews.review_text: In this college, Wi-Fi was available on the premises, and the speed of Wi-Fi was fine. Laboratories, classrooms, and library were regularly cleaned and maintained. The quality of food was fine, and they prepare different food on different days, and special food on special occasions.

reviews.review_heading: Welingkar is worth getting into, and the ROI is great.
reviews.review_text: We have access to Bloomberg terminal and other research resources online. The faculty are very experienced and knowledgeable. All the facilities like hostel, canteen, medical and sports are available. There's even a gymkhana for students. There is a lack of co-curricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great place to learn and develop yourself.
reviews.review_text: Since the classes are online now, the hostel facilities are not available so far. The same is applicable for classrooms. Every year, the Sri Devraj Urs Academy of Higher Education and Research, Kolar awards thirty scholarships to MBBS students. Each scholarship is worth Rs. 25,000/-per year. Thirteen scholarships, named in honor of the late Sri. Ramakrishna Hegde, the former chief minister of Karnataka, are available to students in the general merit category (GM). Candidates that demonstrate merit are eligible for university-funded scholarships [1]. Meritorious students at Sri Devaraj Urs Medical College in Kolar are also awarded scholarships.  The institute awards 15 scholarships to OBC students and 15 scholarships to general merit students according to their performance on university exams (from the second year onwards) and NEET rank (in the first year). Roughly $2.8 million worth of scholarships have been given out in total. The Karnataka government also offers financial aid and scholarships to students. individual_reviews.title: Overall, this college is best for medical aspirants.

content.Placements: A total of 100 seats are available for NEET UG students in this college. After completing 5 year of MBBS course, you get a package ranging from 10-13 LPA at the starting which will increase every year. 1 year of internship is necessary after the completion of 4 years.
content.Infrastructure: A single room is allotted to every student, which is not found in any other government college. Food in the mess is much better than any other mess. Three times meals are available which include breakfast, lunch and dinner.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Review of Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Wardha.

content.Placements: There are many types of job roles like medical officers, senior residents, junior residents, etc. We can join PG courses at this college after completing the UG course. During internships, we work in all departments of the hospital. Internships are also offered in our course, and the stipend is Rs.11,000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: Laboratories are good for practical purposes. Every year, all sports activities are conducted by sports authorities. Our campus has air conditioners, a gym, a basketball court, a volleyball court, a badminton court, and a cricket ground. The hostel facilities are very good, and it provides a single room for every student. The hostel also provides solar water heaters and washing machines. Free Wi-Fi is available, and the speed is very high.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is a good and strict college.

content.Placements: Placements in this college are above 90%. Everyone had a compulsory internship period of 1 year. The salary offered varies but is always above Rs.40000 per month. The internship package is Rs.8000 per month. Roles offered in our course in three camps such as orientation camp, social service camp and ROME camp.
content.Infrastructure: The library in our college has Wi-Fi and e-resources. Our college has the best infrastructure among medical colleges. Hostels provides single room per student but are extremely old. Mess food is claimed healthy but tasteless. The canteen food is cheap in price and in quality. Insects and snakes may bother you in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best central government medical college in Maharashtra.

content.Placements: As it is an MBBS college, the placement rate is almost 100%. Students can join any private hospital or join any government medical hospital at a primary health centre as a medical officer. Many private hospitals in Wardha offer jobs to MBBS students. The average salary starts from 45,000 to 75,000 per month, depending on the location.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The hospital is huge and spacious. Wi-Fi facilities are available all over. Medical facilities and medical store are available within the campus. Labs are well-equipped with instruments and specimens. Classrooms are spacious enough for 100 students, and the library is one of the best among all medical colleges. Canteen food is okay with average quality food.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: MGIMS is the one among colleges in India, which provides good medical education.

content.Placements: MGIMS is a medical college, so placements are almost 100%, and if anyone wants to work after graduation can join in any government or private hospitals. However, those who want to pursue post-graduation course usually take a year to prepare for the same. Salary depends on the working state, but usually, it ranges from Rs. 45,000-1,00,000 for students with MBBS degree and it is higher for those who have completed post-graduation.
content.Infrastructure: Common classrooms and individual seminar hall in each department, Wi-Fi facilities around the campus, a common library and a common reading room, separate gymnasium for boys and girls, adequate sports facilities are available on the campus. Since it is a medical college, so medical facilities are provided in the best possible manner for students.

individual_reviews.title: I am dissatisfied with the management and faculty members.

content.Placements: Only 10% of students in our course got placed. Students offered with a role of MRI and CT were offered with the highest salary, i.e., Rs. 40,000-50,000 per month. The average salary offered in x-ray technology is Rs. 15,000 per month and the average salary offered for CT and MRI students ranges between Rs. 25,000-30,000 per month. Roles offered to students are x-ray, CT and MRI technician. The lowest salary package offered is 1.20 LPA. The average salary package offered is 1.80 LPA. admission_process.title: NIMT - National Institute of Management and Technology Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: NIMT - National Institute of Management and Technology admissionsare primarily entrance-based. However, the institute also admits students based on merit. Candidates can register online for admission to their preferred course. The admission process at NIMT - National Institute of Management and Technology is as per the steps below:
STEP 1: NIMT - National Institute of Management and Technology Application Process 2025

The application mode is online or offline. For admission to the various programmes, aspirants need to apply at the official website, https://www.nimt.ac.in/apply. However, students looking for offline applications may visit the official website to learn more. The application fee ranges between INR 1,000 to INR 1,500 as per the course requirement. Candidates can fill out the application form on the institute's official website.
STEP 2: Selection

The institute considers various entrance exam scores such as CAT or MAT or XAT or GMAT or SNAP or NMAT, ABVMU Master Paramedical Entrance Test, etc, for admission to various courses. Post selection criteria, students must visit the university campus for the counselling process. It also considers the candidates' academic performance for final selection.
STEP 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation

The institute also releases a merit list based on the composite score of the candidates for admission. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theNIMT - National Institute of Management and Technology feeto confirm their seats at the institute.

The median salary for the 3-year UG programme was INR 12,00,000 and the median salary for the 4-year UG programme was INR 25,00,000. In 2021, over 75% of students who completed their MBBS course at AIIMS Delhi secured a job. The average salary package offered was INR 18 LPA. AIIMS Gorakhpur offers compulsory internships to UG and PG-level students. AIIMS Gorakhpur graduates are also highly sought after by hospitals and other healthcare organizations.

faqs.question: How are MBBS placements at AIIMS Gorakhpur?
faqs.answer: AIIMS Gorakhpur has started its first batch in 2019 that would pass out next year. Being a newly established University the information of placement is still not know. But the stipend for Internship has been increased to Rs 23,500 pm from Rs 17,900 pm. During internship students get around 18000–20000 rupees.

The popular programmes offered at UPES School of Health Sciences and Technology are BPharm and MSc. The college offers these courses to students for 4 and 2 years, respectively. These courses are offered across several specialisations like Nutrition & Dietetics and Microbiology. BPharm students can work as Community Pharmacist, Hospital Pharmacist, Clinical Research Associate, Regulatory Affairs Specialist, Quality Control Analyst, Pharmaceutical Sales Representative, etc. These courses emphasise through partnerships with GE Healthcare, hands on, research driven learning to address growing healthcare demands.
Under this programme, the university offers students exchange opportunities with Taipei Medical University (Taiwan), Providence University (Taiwan), and Airlangga University (Indonesia). individual_reviews.title: My life at UPES was filled with joy and fun.

content.Placements: Most of the students for sure get a placement from this college with an average package of around 5 6 Lacs for my course. Top companies recruiting the students include ET Pharma and Reddy’s lab. The students start to get internship offers from the first year itself. In their final year, they are mostly working in some big company as an intern.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides a very good infrastructure facility in the campus. The surrounding environment is also very good, giving the students a very close vibe to the nature. You get excellent hostel facilities with good food and a canteen which provides food 24*7.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Food Technology (Food Biotechnology) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Decent experience, but fees do not seem worth it sometimes.

content.Placements: The batch I am currently enrolled in is the third batch in our course. The first batch of our course is passing out this year and so far, the placements provided by the college have been disappointing. Since it is our first batch, it does make sense that their placements would not be at high-paying jobs; still, it is concerning for younger batches as the ROI is very low. I hope this will change soon. Most of my seniors have already been or have chosen to pursue post-graduation.
content.Infrastructure: One of the best things about UPES is the infrastructure of the Bidholi campus. Students are provided with a well-equipped library with a vast variety of reference books on almost every topic to study from. The classrooms of newer blocks are well furnished and functional; holder blocks lack some of this but the university is working on renovating many of these old classrooms. The Wi-Fi is a bit unreliable, as not everyone is able to properly connect with it and it does not always provide a good connection. I am not an on-campus hosteler so I am not that knowledgeable about situations within hostels.

admission_process.title: UPES School of Health Sciences and Technology Admission process 2025

paragraphs: School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES admission 2025 is open for its offered courses. TheUniversity Of Petroleum And Energy Studiesoffers more than 100 PG, UG, and, Doctoral courses via its eight schools, includingSchool of Advanced Engineering,School of Computer Science,School of Design,School of Business, etc. Among the schools,School of Health Sciences and Technologyis well known to offer admission to BPharm, BSc, BTech, MSc, and PhD programmes.

School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES admission is based on multiple entrance exams, Board Merit, and personal interviews. For BTech, the school accepts the national-level exam JEE Main or the university-level entrance exam that is conducted by UPES University:UPESEAT (University of Petroleum & Energy Studies Engineering Aptitude Test). As for the rest of the courses the school accepts admission based on the board merit and personal interview. Adding on, UPES PAT 2024 (Pharmacy Aptitude Test) is another entrance exam conducted by the University for admission to the BPharm course.

ForSchool of Health Sciences and Technology courses, admissions are both merit and entrance-based. Eligible candidates can apply by visiting the UPES Dehradun's official website. and by selecting the School of Health Sciences and Technology offered courses. Tabulated below are the eligibility criteria and accepting entrance exams forUG, PG, and doctoral-level programmesfor School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES course admissions 2025:

School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES admission is based on board merit, entrance exams, and personal interview. Candidates with valid national-level entrance exams are also eligible for admission. The admission procedure for all the UG and PG courses is as follows:
Step 1: Application Process

School of Health Sciences and Technology, UPES has a multi-step application process. To apply for the programme, candidates must apply via the University of Petroleum and Energy Studies official website. They have to get enrolled on the university's website and choose the desired course from the schools.
Step 2: Entrance Exam and Personal Interview

Candidates will receive SMS regarding further admission procedures based on selection criteria. Details for the Entrance Exam / Personal Interviews will be sent, wherein candidates are required to register on a preferred date and time slot.
Step 3: Entrance/Interview results
Candidates will receive the result of the entrance exam and interview via SMS or they can also check it in the official website of the University.
Step 4: Seat Finalisation

After completion of the selection round, the university releases a provisional offer letter that is issued based on the entrance exam and interview. Candidate must pay the admission fee to reserve/block their seat before the expiry date of the admission offer.

There are two types of hostel rooms which are triple sharing with common washrooms and double sharing with attached washrooms. The hostel campus has multiple cafes offering a variety of food options.

reviews.review_heading: My memorable journey of UPES.
reviews.review_text: College has two separate  campuses as It's small because it's situated in a mountainous area. There is always a parking issue; space is very limited. College classrooms are very special. The library is also big, and books are arranged properly. One library is always available for service in exams; it is open the whole day. Hostel rooms are triple-sharing; there are common washrooms and bathrooms. The mess floor is very average, not good at all. The hostel feels very high, so it is not worth it. ...

reviews.review_heading: Very good Allied Health Sciences Courses .

reviews.review_heading: My life at UPES was filled with joy and fun.
reviews.review_text: The college provides a very good infrastructure facility in the campus. The surrounding environment is also very good, giving the students a very close vibe to the nature. You get excellent hostel facilities with good food and a canteen which provides food 24*7.

reviews.review_heading: Decent experience, but fees do not seem worth it sometimes.

faqs.answer: Yes, SRMU Lucknow accepts JEE score. faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to NIMS University?
faqs.answer: No, the university does not offer direct admissions. NIMS Universityadmission is both merit and entrance-based. Admission to most of the UG and PG courses is done through the relevant entrance exam. However, for certain courses, the university also accepts students on a merit basis. Students are offered a wide range of courses at UG, PG, diploma, certificate, and doctoral levels. To know more, students can connect with the admission help desk of the university.

faqs.question: Is NIMS University, Jaipur a good university?
faqs.answer: Yes, NIMS University Jaipur is a good university. NIMS University Rajasthan offers University Grants Commission (UGC) approved courses to students. NIMS University Jaipur is recognised by the Government of India, University Grants Commission (UGC), MCI, DCI, PCI (Pharmacy Council of India), INC, RNC, BCI, AICTE, RPC, COA (Council of Architecture), and AIU (Association of Indian Universities). NIMS University Jaipur also offers financial assistance to students. The university also offers placement opportunities to candidates. Thehighest packageoffered at NIMS University during placements 2023 wasINR 20 LPA.

faqs.question: Is NIMS University, Jaipur a private university?
faqs.answer: NIMS University Rajasthan is a self-financed university in Rajasthan and was established under the NIMS University ACT. NIMS Rajasthan is accredited by NAAC, NABH, and NABL. The university has received the Best University in India award for placement by CEGR, New Delhi for 2022. Being a private university, NIMS University Jaipur, through 24 constituent colleges, offers UG, PG Diploma Ph.D. and other courses to students across the Design, Engineering, Medical, and other streams.

faqs.question: What are the key academic programmes offered by NIMS University?

placement_data.title: NIMS University Jaipur Placement Overview 2026
paragraphs: NIMS University Jaipur placements held recently recorded a highest package (overseas) of INR 120 LPA .The highest domestic package offered was INR 60 LPA . More than 500 companies took part during the placement drive.

The highest and average package offered to Engineering students during NIMS University Jaipur placements 2025 were INR 35 LPA and INR 5.5 LPA respectively. While the highest and average package offered to the Business students of the batch 2025 were INR 21 LPA and INR 6.8 LPA, respectively. The School of Law students got the highest package of INR 10.5 LPA , whereas the average package offered was INR 6.8 LPA.

71 recruiters participated during NIMS University Jaipur placements for the School of Engineering and presented 215 job offers to the students of the batch 2025. Similarly, 42 recruiters participated for the School of Business placements and presented 153 job offers to the students of the batch 2025. The students of the School of Law secured 65 job offers , Physiotherapy students secured 78 , Humanities students received 53 job offers , and Paramedical students received 81 job offers during the 2025 placements at NIMS University Jaipur.

Some of the top recruiters who visited at NIMS University Jaipur in 2025 include TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, Capegemini, Samsung, Adani, Wipro, Tata, HP, HCL, L&T, Gammon, Genisis, Amazon, Centum, Bajaj Hero, Bosch , KPMG , etc.
Earlier, during the placement drive 2024 , highest international and domestic package offered was INR 1.2 Crore per annum and INR 60 LPA .

review_content.Placements: The overall placement record of our college is decent, and it is improving with each upcoming batch. This year, the highest package for the B.Tech course is around 56 LPA, which is a pretty nice record. The college organizes pre-placement drives in the final year to make the students placement-ready and boost their performance. The median package record for my course is around 8 LPA-9 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of the college and hostel is top-tier. The classrooms and labs are digitalized. The lectures are delivered through PPTs, and practical implementations are conducted in the smart labs. The hostel rooms are well furnished, and the overall facilities are much better. Sports, gym, and other facilities are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) with academic support of IBM - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Approximately 50 percent of the students gets places with an average package of 6 LPA to 7 LPA. Major companies like Infosys, Microsoft, Google, etc., come on campus for placements. For my course major roles offered are Data Scientist, Data Analyst, DBA, etc. Course is designed to make students interview ready.
content.Infrastructure: College have really good infrastructure with some of the best labs like AI and robotics lab, printing lab, and multiple computer labs with good Wi-Fi and internet connection. After academics there is a big football turf and multiple sport facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) with academic support of IBM - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Most of the students got placed, with average package going up to 6LPA to 7 LPA, big companies are regular at campus and in my course. Most students got an excellent package in good companies with the support of the academic structure, which is designed to tackle interview-related questions and domain-specific ones, such as Data Scientist, Data analysis, DBA, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a good and efficient infrastructure with labs across every specialisation, such as robotics lab, printing lab, multiple computer labs with the latest technologies. Wi-Fi connectivity is excellent with coverage across campus. Apart from academics, we have a good football ground, cricket nets, and multiple sports facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) with academic support of IBM - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My overall college life experience.

content.Placements: The overall placement record of our college is decent, and it is improving with each upcoming batch. This year, the highest package for the B.Tech course is around 56 LPA, which is a pretty nice record. The college organizes pre-placement drives in the final year to make the students placement-ready and boost their performance. The median package record for my course is around 8 LPA-9 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of the college and hostel is top-tier. The classrooms and labs are digitalized. The lectures are delivered through PPTs, and practical implementations are conducted in the smart labs. The hostel rooms are well furnished, and the overall facilities are much better. Sports, gym, and other facilities are also available.

individual_reviews.course: BCA (AI & Data Science) with academic support of IBM & powered by Microsoft Certifications - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The review is that overall, good decision-making to study in this college.

content.Placements: About the placement, overall, 75 to 85 percent of the students are placed in or off campus. The highest package in this course is 56.6 LPA, the average is 7 LPA to 8 LPA, and the lowest is 3.5 LPA to 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Wipro, Deloitte, etc. Roles offered are data analytics and AI engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good because it gives us a wide range of opportunities for a successful and bright future. Labs and classrooms are also given good facilities like a smart board, and Wi-Fi is the most important thing in any college to make a bright future for the student. Mess of our hostel is also good, canteens are well cleaned and well-maintained. The most important thing is hygiene, which is well judged. Sports facilities are very good, and a wide variety of games are available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Physiotheraphy (BPT) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is a great university to gain knowledge and experience.

content.Placements: The university has tie-ups with top healthcare companies such as CK Birla Hospital, Sarvodaya Hospital, Artemis Hospital, morengo asian hospital, Asian Hospital, Sports Authority of India, Max Healthcare Institute Ltd., and many others. The university also provides its students with paid internships.
content.Infrastructure: The university has specialized labs for practical learning. The campus has free Wi-Fi, is fully air-conditioned, has sports grounds, a parking lot, etc. I never had any problems related to ragging, the quality of food, etc. I like the campus, it's big and well-maintained.

Sports, gym, and other facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the best college for M.Sc. in Computer Science course.
reviews.review_text: The hotels are old, so the hotel facilities are relatively good. Hostel food is manageable. However, the layout of the main lecture hall, library, CSC, Dogra Hall, and assembly halls is good. The Wi-Fi speed is decent, but there is a daily limit of 10GB, this excess usually leads to a temporary ban.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for the M.Sc. in Computer Science course.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are properly furnished with a projector, speaker, board, air-conditioning, and feature comfortable seating for students. Wi-Fi service is available 24x7 on campus. Locker service is provided for all students in the department building. Two generous living rooms are available, while bathrooms are equipped with individual geysers. Meals in the mess are mediocre.

reviews.review_heading: Review in the Shiksha college.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities were available for the students in my course. Infrastructure of college was also superb. Wi-Fi, classroom, library, and all things were present for the students. The quality of food in college canteen was so tasty and healthy. Medical facility was available but sports and games were not present.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college to focus on life, with good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classroom with projector and computers, and a large library with all books useful for international business subjects. No hostel is provided; it is a large campus on Street Number 6 near Lifestyle Lane in a housing area. There is a gym and a large indoor stadium at the college for sports like basketball and badminton. The canteen food is average.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with completing my degree from this college.
reviews.review_text: Having studied here for 3 complete years, I can really say I appreciate the campus and its infrastructure facilities. It is clean and hygienic in every corner of the campus, and we have very functional labs and a big and well-stocked library. We have an indoor stadium present and a clean and hygienic canteen.

reviews.review_heading: Review by Anjali Kolli of St. Francis College for Women.
reviews.review_text: The facilities available in this course are so superb, the classrooms are so good, but Wi-Fi is not present in my college. The quality of food in my college canteen is good. Medical facilities are available, but sports and games are available in my course.

reviews.review_heading: I like this college as I have more access to the courses here.
reviews.review_text: As a science student, I really appreciate the infrastructure and facilities in this college. As we spend more of our time in labs rather than classrooms, we clearly observed our labs to be well-equipped and functional that we can easily access anything we want.

reviews.review_heading: I am completely satisfied with this campus case, and I wanted to join this for a long back.
reviews.review_text: We have a well-maintained campus and well-furnished benches, tables, and a chair. It has well-equipped labs. It has a very big and neatly arranged library. We have an indoor stadium, various playgrounds and a neat, clean and hygienic canteen where we have a lot of varieties and fresh food.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied joining this college because my parents wanted me to join, and I like it too.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus is well-maintained, with well-ventilated classrooms and well-furnished benches, tables, and chairs. It has well-equipped labs, a large library, and a hygienic canteen. The quality of food is also good, and we often play in our indoor stadium.

reviews.review_heading: Utilising the resources you have.
reviews.review_text: Overall college is giving its best to help students acquire or gain as much knowledge as they can. I live in a private hostel as our college won't have a college hostel. The food in our hostel is okay.

reviews.review_heading: As a woman, I like this college and it offers us good placements.
reviews.review_text: At my college, we have many strict rules, and we must follow them. The security is very good as it is a women's college. We are required to wear the dress code given by the college. We have 24/7 medical facilities and a Wi-Fi campus. We can play many games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: A college where an individual can find responsibility and concentration on their career.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is well-constructed and well-maintained. We have fully equipped classes with projectors, fully equipped labs, and a library. We have a clean and hygienic mess and canteen. We even have a health centre and an indoor stadium too.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The college has good Wi-Fi, and vast library with numerous books for people of all courses, and a good seating area with ventilation and an internet lab. Computer labs and science labs are equipped with the latest technology and good facilities with proper seating, availability, and air conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: Review of St. Francis College for Women
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in my college are so good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and library are all present in my college. The quality and facilities of the hostel are so good, and the food is delicious. Medical facilities are also present, and sports and games are available in my course.

reviews.review_heading: St. francis college for women.
reviews.review_text: As a women's college, there is strict monitoring of the dress code, hairstyles, shoes, and ID cards. There are more than the required number of security personnel at the gate, and wardens in the hostel ensure the students' safety. All vital resources are available within the campus.

review_summary.college_name: North Delhi Municipal Corporation Medical College and Hindu Rao Hospital Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Average infrastructure but best quality teachers.

content.Placements: There are 60 seats per batch in my college and MBBS courses. You can take admission via the NEET-UG entrance exam. It does not have very good infrastructure but the faculty is from top institutions like AIIMS DELHI, MAMC, etc. Our college has the best teacher-to-student ratio. Every teacher can have word-to-word conversations with each student, as there is less strength in our batch.
content.Infrastructure: It does not have many facilities and does not have very good infrastructure. There is a limited Wi-Fi connection. The library is present, but it is not open 24 hours a day. It will remain open until 9 p.m. For every subject, there are different labs. There is a college canteen. There are various food shops outside the campus. And changing out places to enjoy. Limited sports facilities are present.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Medical Lab Technology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of North Delhi Municipal Corporation Medical College and Hindu Rao Hospital.

content.Placements: Our batch has 30 students. This is a government college. It does not provide placements for this course. No company comes for placements. Our college provides a 6-month internship in their hospital. Medical lab technician role is provided after graduation.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available only for staff members. Classrooms are good with lights, fans, and cross ventilation. Library has two floors, and the best part is the library's balcony. A laboratory is present in every department like pathology, microbiology, biochemistry, anatomy, and physiology. Hostel is not available for MLT students. Hostels are for MBBS and nursing students. Our college has two messes. Both serve food good in quality and taste. The canteen is not available. Medical facilities are provided. Sports and games are not available.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a good government college.

content.Placements: Internships are mandatory for all students. The average stipend offered ranges between Rs.25,000 - Rs.30,000 per month. After completing the course, students can join as a junior president or can go for post-graduation.
content.Infrastructure: We have well-developed rooms. They have Wi-Fi. Electricity is available 24X7 in our college. The food served in the mess is good. Our college has a peaceful environment for students to study and prepare for other competitive exams like NEET, PG, etc. The mess provides a variety of food items.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Good college with good faculty members and great experience.

content.Placements: This college comes under Indraprastha University which has a great PG quota seat for IPU students. And it provides a great uplift to PG ratio as compared to DU University. The advantage is that you will get a better option with some easy competition.
content.Infrastructure: College doesn't have a good infrastructure but it provides almost all kinds of facilities they can. In the G block, we have a reading room on 5 floors and a library on 7 floors. And on each floor, we have different kinds of labs also like pathology and microbiology lab.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because of nice faculty, small batch size .

content.Placements: 100% placement Depends on marks and skills of a student Apollo, fortis etc. 100 percent. Top roles are to take history of a patient, perform clinical procedures during posting and internship, manage various fests and cultural functions.
content.Infrastructure: Well furnished classrooms with good location. Library timing upto 8 pm well-equipped labs. Hostel accommodation is poor Canteen is average. Sports and games exposure is very less with no playing ground and no indoor sports.

faqs.question: When did NTA release the NEET 2024 result?
faqs.answer: NTA released the re-revised scorecard on July 26, 2024. In this scorecard, the score has been revised as per the Supreme Court verdict of removing the bonus marks awarded earlier for the controversial Physics question, and deducting one mark from those who marked incorrect answer options. The city and centre-wise result data such as number of candidates appeared and scores obtained, by masking candidates' personal data was released on July 21, as per the Supreme Court order given on the hearing dated July 18, 2024. The NEET 2024 result for the re-exam, which was conducted on June 23, was declared on July 1, day day after the slated date. The final answer keys for the NEET 2024 re-exam was released by June 30, ahead of the result declaration. Earlier, the result of NEET 2024 was declared by NTA on June 4, 2024, 10 days ahead of the original schedule, which was June 14, 2024.
