overview_faqs.answer: N.C. Medical College and Hospital is a distinguished institution offering MD, MS, MBBS. Students can choose these programs to launch their careers in the Medicine & Health Sciences field. N.C. Medical College and Hospital is known for its dedicated and experienced faculty members committed to delivering these courses. N.C. Medical College and Hospital has received an impressive review rating of 3.95 based on student feedback at Shiksha. Additionally, it has earned ratings of 4.25 for Campus Life, 3.75 for Placements, 4 for Faculty, and 3.75 for Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: N.C. Medical College and Hospital Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of N.C. Medical College and Hospital.

content.Placements: Placements at our college are good. It depends on the skills acquired by you during your training. Students after completing medical officer jobs, work as junior residents. There are a good number of cases during internships and a lot of students from our previous batch have bagged good positions in PG exams.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has an air-conditioned library and reading room, as well as Wi-Fi access. The sports ground is huge and all sports are being played. Classrooms are pretty decent with full audio-visual support and fully equipped labs, but there are no adequate microscopes, which is a con. We have two cafeterias with good quality food. Mess food is not that good. However, you must eat in a well-equipped hospital with all the medical facilities and a 24X7 emergency room.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Only 3 batches yet but overall 3/5 experience. Not much ragging, Hostels are average.

content.Placements: Since MBBS is a prestigious professional course job offerings are many. All it takes is how you perform in NEXT exam, if you will clear that (college provides library, above average faculty, 70% Environment), clearing this exam will provide you subtle Government job opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are average, but new floors are being added to Senior hostels. Wi-Fi facilities is good (2mbps), classrooms are AC. , library is average as seats are basic with wooden tables, but AC is there. Hostels for first years (freshers) is 4/5 very beautifully located away from senior block to avoid ragging like activities. Mess food is average, but strict actions are taken always by the Food committee and New principal of college. Medical facilities are obviously good as it's a medical college itself. Sports and games are majorly : Volleyball and cricket. As only 3 batches are there, sportsmen are very less. But a huge ground is there.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Great college life but academically not so good.

content.Placements: The first batch got passed out in May 2022. So placements are still not started. Most of them go for a drop to prepare for NEET, PG, Or some have joined for junior residency in some private institutions. Average yearly package of 10 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is great. Green campus, Library way too small for 450-600 students. Wi-Fi is available. Lecture theatres are average. The sports ground is there. No gym. Mess food is pathetic. One general store and one cafeteria which is operated by the mess contractor only so it is also not good.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied with our college because of good faculty members and placements.

content.Placements: Our college has a 100% placement record, and all students become good doctors. Doctors have a very important role in society. In our college, about 100% of the students from our course get jobs in good hospitals. The highest salary package offered to us is 25 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our hostel facilities are good, and the food served is also tasty. Our college has a good chief, and sometimes, the food is oily, but its taste is very well. The food served here is also same as the food prepared at our home and will be digested easily. Our college has a sports team, and we are good.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with college. It has a good infrastructure, but it is not worth the money.

content.Placements: In MBBS, there are no such placements, and we should just crack NEET PG. The highest or the lowest packages are not offered. Top colleges are in Delhi, where we can do PG or go for other options. All students have to do internships at this college.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility is present here, but we have to pay a separate fee for that. Classrooms are good with an AC facility. The library is pretty decent. The quality of food is very poor. The canteen is also not that good. Sports facility is not so good. Grounds are maintained.
